claims.proves: on a healthy page PROCEED; a drifted primary selector self-corrects to a working fallback and PROCEEDs; a fully-missing composer, logged-out, or rate-limited page STOP_HANDOFFs; cloudflare RETRY_AFTER_RELOADs (never solved); send-button absence BEFORE typing is advisory (not a false STOP); cross-run DOM change is flagged; and the doctor stays wired before typing with no captcha-solving
